name: 33471-batchdecode-llama31-8bfp8-1gpu
model: RedHatAI/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-FP8, no substitution. Ungated, 8.5 GB in two safetensors shards, already in the local HF cache.
hardware: 1x NVIDIA H100 80GB HBM3, one node, one GPU.
parallelism: tp1. No tensor, pipeline, expert or data parallelism.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM, 32 decoder layers, hidden 4096, intermediate 14336, 32 query heads over 8 KV heads (GQA), head_dim 128, 131072 max positions, vocab 128256.
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=16. Warmup the first 25% of the bound, pinned to `requests`. Bound 1200 requests, safety 1800 s, roughly a ten-minute run.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text` over `/v1/chat/completions`, single turn, no shared prefix, no structure: 1024 prompt tokens in and 1024 tokens out, both fixed with no stdev, seed 42. Declaring `output_tokens` makes guidellm set `ignore_eos`, so every request generates exactly 1024 tokens.
purpose: An 8-billion-parameter chat assistant writing long-form answers from page-length prompts for 16 concurrent users on one GPU.
launch:
# The engine's command line: a bare FP8 serving line, nothing tuned. Everything not listed
# -- attention backend, chunked prefill, cuda graph, max running requests, dtype, context
# length, quantization -- is left at this commit's default or read off the checkpoint.
# host / port / served-model-name are owned by the launcher.
model-path: RedHatAI/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-FP8
tp-size: 1
# The one deviation from a bare launch line: written down so the KV pool is a stated
# quantity rather than whatever the default happens to be at this commit.
mem-fraction-static: 0.85
